mapper.select: SELECT ddpr.dates, ddpr.pkg, ddpr.country, ddpr.version, ddpr.user_num, durpfd.user_num pkg_user_num, IFNULL((ddpr.user_num / durpfd.user_num), 0) user_rate, IFNULL(dprg.total_cost, 0) pkg_cost, IFNULL(dprg.total_change_cost, 0) pkg_change_cost, IFNULL((ddpr.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * dprg.total_cost, 0) cost, IFNULL((ddpr.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * dprg.total_change_cost, 0) change_cost, IFNULL((ddpr.user_num / durpfd.user_num) * dprg.total_change_cost / ddpr.user_num, 0) cpi FROM dws_daily_package_register ddpr LEFT JOIN dws_user_register_pkg_full_daily durpfd on (ddpr.dates = durpfd.dates and ddpr.pkg = durpfd.pkg) LEFT JOIN (SELECT dpr.dates, dpr.pkg, sum(dpr.cost) total_cost, sum(dpr.change_cost) total_change_cost FROM dwd_promotion_record dpr WHERE dpr.dates = #{dates} group by dpr.dates, dpr.pkg) dprg on (dprg.dates = ddpr.dates and dprg.pkg = ddpr.pkg) WHERE ddpr.dates = #{dates}
